datasheet.measures: presence of plastic, liquid or powder through non-metal walls (non-flush M18)
datasheet.source: ifm datasheet KG5065-02 (French): sensing range 12 mm, hysteresis 1...15 % of sensing range, NO/NC selectable, PNP/NPN, IO-Link 1.1 COM1, DeviceID 387, M18x1 body 87 mm long. No switch point range in mm is given, so only hysteresis is a setting.

settings.name: Hysteresis
settings.default_source: studio default, not a factory setting
settings.source: ifm KG5065-02 datasheet: hysteresis 1...15 % of sensing range. The IODD hysteresis (61.3, Conf_FC-BDC1) is an unscaled 16-bit value with factory value 18 and no range, so it cannot be mapped to % here.
